reproducibility_gaps: Environment requirements are component-specific and not fully version-pinned: the root compiler/toolchain, SciPy, gnuplot, MATLAB/Octave and optional GUI dependencies are documented without one exact cross-interface environment lock.
Cross-validation and subset-selection documentation describes randomized operations, but an explicit user-facing seed control or reference seed is not documented in the inspected use-path guidance.
Examples document commands and some illustrative metrics, but a canonical reference-output set is not supplied across the supported CLI, Python, Java and MATLAB/Octave workflows.
notes: R2 reflects pinned available source, clear licensing, substantial component-specific build/install guidance and identified use paths; incomplete version locking and reference-result controls block a higher static level.
